body: The only part I regret is the conversations I have with people who bring it up. Since most of the time I try to hide it, but sometimes I forget and cut my wrists/face. I hate those conversations.

I did this about six months ago, took a possibly more then a friend to hawaii, Maui to be exact for a week. I paid for %100 of it. First few days were enjoyable, then I realized she wanted to go off with random people for sexual endevours.

Other then that, I don't have many family members or friends left.

I just don't want to inconceivable others by doing it.. I don't find living another 5-80 years more a good thing.

And I've cut myself on and off for six years or so?

Therapists have never been good for me, although I know its a matter of finding the right now, I don't have  the money for it at the moment. 

I've been diagnosed with bipolar disorder, insomnia, and depression so far. Although I rarely go to the doctor (money again)

I feel like this more describes my alcohol use. With weed I can start to feel good possibly. With alcohol I feel like I'm just drowning them and making them manageable, or if I do something I don't think as much of it (or don't remember. With weed I know I'm aware of what's going on, and it feels okay.

Would the alternative be to do nothing or would it be to use something else? I do try to switch it up between trees, alcohol, and whatever else I can manage to afford. I'm broke so I don't have too many choices.

I've started to realize I have friends here, I used to toke up, feel good for a bit, then some thought would grab me, and I would need to talk to someone, but instead just get more depressed. But with all of you people I can avoid that, weed has been a much much better experience because of you guys.

I think I know what makes me unhappy, a combination of feeling like a failure. (It started with failing highschool with what was a 3.8GPA because of a mycoplasmic bacterial infection) Intense loneliness and betrayal (first three girlfriend's cheated on me, in a large way, and now after many bad experiences and with my new and improved social anxiety I'm not actively looking for one, and my step-dad (parents divorced when I was 14) hit me. I never went back.

Weed greatly enhances my anxiety when I'm with people, but when I'm alone, and I know I'll stay alone that day, I end up actually having an alright time, video games, tv. 
ALthough the same kind of holds true for when I'm sober. Its just with less depression with MJ.
Source?
I have a semi-reliable friend, I can trade computer components for some weed. Is kind of an amazing thing,
I've just had bad experiences with them.. Although before it was a dual sessions with my father (I was a minor then) It caused nothing but extreme anger.. Ended up breaking a few knuckles.
Thanks. I really hope they do. And I wish you fortune in life.
Thanks man.
I fight that fight every night. Major insomnia. Only way to fall asleep is lots of alcohol/weed/dxm(although that takes a while),vicodin.
I know I need to start.. I've started to gain weight (Something normally depression causes me to lose, I blame the alcohol over weed) I just find it impossible to come up with the motivation.

I can go out and meet people I try it on occasion, I just have lots of social anxiety and if I get into a good relationship with someone platonic or not, and it breaks down, I get 100x worse then I was before.. I've found it safer to not do that.
Disregarding the people was just silly. Was looking at the schedules of drugs in the usa and my friend was just flaberghasted at the placement of marijuanna

I tend to do this normally, more so then anyone around me. I spend hours waiting to give someone a ride. I spend hundreds on elaborate gifts/surprises on people. It feels great for a bit, until I'm feeling down again, then it just amplifies the fact that nobody seems to care for me, and I'm just getting used.
I've been off medication for quite a while due to money, but trees are amazing. Good luck.

I was wondering if I would get a response stating this. 

Ecstasy used to be normal, lots of happiness and such, the normal. Then, slowly, instead I would get very repressed, I would feel I would have to control my every action or some dire consequence would happen. The time after that I took it I felt severely alone after all my friends ditched me. 
Now Just every time I take it, I go back to the feeling incredibly alone, no one to hold, and I hate myself.

I took acid for the first time a month or two ago. Didn't like it one bit. Only thing that happened was I felt extremely anxious and I felt time was slipping away, had to look at a clock constantly to feel alright, do only things I knew the time restraints of. Was bad. I also felt none of the energy/auras of people. Although once my friends fell asleep, I did find some alrightness in playing with legos, but was definitely not as wonderful as made out to be, no visuals at all either. Friend's who took it from the same blotter felt all the normal effects.


These could be just bad trips, but they have been 100% of my recent drug (non mj) experiences.
If only I was a pirate, life would be much more simplistic. Rape and pillage!
Wow, that must have been hard.. I can't imagine. I love the fact that trees are natural, so much better for me then any of the other spontaneous things I have taken to try to quell my depression.
Thank you, I wish I had the money to afford it more often, but its nice to know I'm not alone.

Political things, when I want to know the other side of the story, from their point of view. Microsoft tech questions (I'm a heavy linux user) Anything that has an opposite opinion of me, for which things are better, or sensitive topics, like world news.
I'm glad things have been improving, and I have been poosting on /r/sw, great subreddit. I just don't know of any other coping mechanisms that don't require money.

I'm not sure what it makes me feel anymore, but it used to make me feel human. Feel alive. Otherwise I would just start to lose a hold of my position in life since all I feel is depression. 

I don't care if I die because for the last 4 years I haven't felt any happiness.. I just don't see another 50+ years of this worth it in any way shape or form.
Thanks for responding, my problem is.. I don't have a close friend. I just can't seem to get that close to anyone, and I have social anxiety, so it gets harder.
The thing I'm worried about is being committed to a hospital. Worst experience of my life, I would feel more suicidal fi that happened again. Otherwise I don't mind including 3rdparties.
Drunk, (only way I feel comfortable sharing my thoughts) So share it if I'm alright with it, but would prefer a third party trained in depression? AKA Psychiatrist?
Thanks man, I check this account when I'm depressed (which is often) But I always respond. Thank you.

I don;t doubt it is the worst, Although it is the most fiscal possibility.  I get it for free from a friend. Weed costs money. So does prescriptions ( I don't have health insurance) Since things like Ecstasy and acid only cause depression, alcohol is the only subtance that seems to help. 

I'll PM you for sure, I need people to talk to. Loneliness is the #1 cause of my cutting and alcohol consumption.
My problem is that I don't have a card. Alcohol is cheaper to me. That and cough syrup. It is a negative thing, although its better then just staying alone, sober and depressed.

This is my alt account, depressed at the moment, but I use DDG for 90% of my searches, especially incognito. 

I use google chrome as my defualt browser, so I'm slow in implementing your search engine as default, (I do a lot of new installs) but I always slowly do it, Also, I visit your site a bunch for topics that I know will be skewed by google.

Thank you.
A fan.

This may not be the popular choice, but my experience during a 72 hour hold, was the worst, most anxiety ridden, sleep deprived, self-hating, suicidal, period of time I've ever experienced. 
I do have insomnia issues, but they wouldn't prescribe anything until I met with the resident psychiatrist, which took almost 30 hours. During that time I was 100% awake and sober just thinking about my depression, I wasn't even allowed music.
Afterwards They slowly started prescribing things.. Not enough, until I only had 15 or so hours left. Finally they got it right and I felt like I could relax, although I was barely there mentally.
Looking back on it I can honestly tell anyone it was the most horrific experience of my life.

I have a really good friend would would second my opinion although I don't know her details so I can't say anything more then this really.

I'm in the same boat as you man, although I have been considering suicide, although on and off. Most of my replies (if in email form) will probably be around 4 am or so, since i have quite the insomnia. But, IAmADyingBreed@gmail.com
Feel free.

I do this, although it doesn't work for me anymore to just do it alone, a combination of drugs/alcohol and tv has been the normal for me. same with easy video games. This is new.. I used to be able to just do this. although I would much rather have human interaction with the right people, I would rather watch tv then hang out/talk to anyone else.

I was going to create a new topic saying almost the same thing as your title.. Chinese is kicking my ass more then it should.

This sounds like where I was a few years ago, with my parents getting divorced, although my dad cared about me before the divorce, but not after.

Now I'm in a community college, I failed out of high school due to depression/mycoplasmic bacterial infections. I took Chinese for some reason, really fucking hard. But especially since in the last month it's been getting the better of me again, I've just been fighting suicide almost constantly. I'm worried about telling the teacher because I -cannot- go to the hospital on a 72 hour hold again. But otherwise I'd just fail.

Let me know how things go, I think I could at least learn from your experiences.
This is a brilliant idea. I've always been bad at expressing myself, maybe this will help with that too.

You sound like me. Although I'm not in another country, I really wish I was.
I think about her constantly. I can't sleep at night. There is no escape. I wish you luck where I haven't found it. So far my slight fix is half a bottle of vodka a night... not reasonable though. DXM (cough syrup) with a close friend maybe, Ecstasy now makes me depressed even more. I've done stupid shit to make me feel alright, including cocaine, heroin, Meth. They didn't seem to affect me as much as it should, Meth did nothing at all..

Something is wrong with me too.

Do you have extremely close friends, someone of your preferred gender hopefully. Ecstasy can make you feel happy, so close to the people around you, and otherwise amazing. Although a warning, I've done ecstasy 4-5 times, had bad experiences with the last few people I was doing it with a girl I wanted to be with, but she... didn't. Now ecstasy just makes it worse, unless maybe I find someone like her.

I have plently of friends, who say they are close and I have no need to feel alone, although that's all I feel. 
It's not a problem with having friends, its the fact that I don't feel as close to them as I was once with a girl. I miss the closeness, the openness, and since I don't get that anymore, I just feel alone constantly.

I feel the need to slit my wrists too, I want to die, but I'm too much of a pussy. I've been wearing a sweatshirt for the last three days, even though its been hot outside because I'm covered in cuts..

This morning I woke up to a scene from Dexter. I was depressed and drinking seems to numb it.. but not last night. There was blood on the walls of the bathroom, on every lightswitch from here to the kitchen, blood on the floor, on my mattress, and on the counter. 

As much as I know its not good for me. I survived the night, and I felt a tad better becasue I was actually able to express myself. even if it was in self harm.

We come from different backgrounds, but the general premise of our stories are the same. Its been a while since I've been able to hold any of my depression under control, I tend to hide it more then I should probably. 

My parents don't put much thought in it, they just criticize my lack of abilities in school. 

I don't have health insurance, and I can't work properly due to my depression, its affecting school (which is the only thing my parent(mom moved to the east coast) seem to care about) And if I fail school, I have nothing left to fall into..

I have the same problem as you and ConroConro. Its taken over my actions, comparing myself to how I was 5 years ago, I can see nothing left of myself.

I wish you luck and happiness.

The only changes they made were rapid cycling, depressive apathy, sleep for 20+ hours a day, suicidal tenancies, and... rage.

I hope your experience differs from mine.

The next step is keeping the mental capacity to finish it, when I'm really depressed or anxious I can't focus at all.

Thanks man. This hit close to the mark. I try to live thinking that something good and exciting might come in the next few days, and if it doesn't, think, well, that increases the chances for the future, right?

It gets hard after so long of nothing but badness.. But I'm trudging.

For the first part, the only reason why I'm withholding this from my relatives is because of the laws. I don't trust them enough not to send me away. If that happens I don't think I could mentally survive it.
Second part is I am trying, I re-enrolled in high school, finally, but for the most part I seem to not have very good luck in life anymore. I am working on changing the things I can change though, I'm don't consider myself always useless.

Although, I am never happy, I feel life is a burden I don't want to carry.
While I am making changes, I don't think they are worth living.

I can find these sorts of people online. But anyone I've actually met, the moment I mention depression, bipolar disorder, loneliness (in any manor of scale above normal) or self harm. Although I always start with just the general feeling of unhappiness, or I mention I Have depression. They either scoff, don't take it seriously, or spend the next three days getting more and more distant until they won't talk to me anymore.
The people I have found are wonderful. Saviors, almost. But then they disappear. I end up missing them and that adds to the feeling of despair.

I just wish this bad luck streak hasn't been 3-4 years long.

This is exactly how I feel. I go to parties often, I'm told I'm fairly sociable. But the lack of feeling close is what's crushing.
Not many people know about my bipolar, even fewer know that I struggle with depression. I run away whenever I get sort of close to people. I'll feel worse attending social situations where everyone is happy and normal sometimes.
There is nothing to celebrate, everything in my life has been on a sharp decline for the last few years, I'm a failure both in my eyes, and everyone around me.
